name: Fogas
title: Heavyweight
description: A big smiling brawler in a cream tee, black shorts, and glasses. Slow, thick, and happy to walk through you.
source_description: Male fighter, heavy chubby build, short brown hair, glasses, cream white t-shirt with pocket, black shorts, watch, cheerful tank.
special_desc: A slow armored belly bump that dumps you on the floor.
ultimate_desc: A gas blast that hits now, stuns, then poisons.
